order.expiredDesc: The 15-minute payment window has passed. Please create a new order.

qrGenerate.title: Pay with Points
qrGenerate.step1: Show the QR screen to the cashier
qrGenerate.step2: The cashier scans the QR code on the POS terminal
qrGenerate.step3: Receive a confirmation notification for successful payment

scan.title: Scan to pay order
scan.hint: Fit the QR code on the cashier screen inside the frame
scan.hintSource: Staff creates this code when you pay an order with coins
scan.rejectedHint: Scan the coin payment QR code on the cashier screen.
scan.permBody: The app needs the camera to scan payment QR codes at the counter.
scan.permDeniedBody: Turn on camera access for the app in Settings to scan codes.

confirm.title: Confirm coin payment
confirm.loyaltyNote: Loyalty points for this order go to the person who placed it.
confirm.safeToRetry: The connection dropped but no coins were deducted. You can try again.
confirm.maybePaid: This code has been paid. Check your coin history to confirm.
confirm.stillOffline: The result is unknown because you are offline. Don't pay again until it can be checked.

errors.alreadyPaid: This code has already been paid.
errors.cancelled: This code was cancelled. Please ask staff for a new one.
errors.orderChanged: The order has changed. Please ask staff for a new code.
errors.missingData: Couldn't read the code, please scan again.
errors.mismatch: This code no longer matches the order. Please ask staff for a new one.
errors.insufficient: You don't have enough coins for this order.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired, please log in again.
errors.forbidden: Only customer accounts can pay with coins.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong, please try again.

voucherConflict.title: Incompatible voucher
voucherConflict.descSuffix: Continuing will remove the voucher from your order.
